scripts.test:e2e:list: node -e 'const { spawnSync } = require(`node:child_process`); let failed = false; for (const config of process.argv.slice(1)) { const run = spawnSync(`playwright`, [`test`, `--list`, `--reporter=json`, `--config`, config], { encoding: `utf8`, maxBuffer: 1 << 28 }); let report; try { report = JSON.parse(run.stdout); } catch { report = { errors: [{ message: `no JSON list: ${String(run.stderr || run.stdout || run.error).slice(0, 2000)}` }] }; } const files = new Set(); let tests = 0; const walk = suite => { for (const spec of suite.specs ?? []) { tests += spec.tests.length; files.add(spec.file); } (suite.suites ?? []).forEach(walk); }; (report.suites ?? []).forEach(walk); const errors = report.errors ?? []; if (run.status !== 0 || errors.length > 0 || tests === 0) { failed = true; console.error(`e2e load guard FAILED for ${config}: exit ${run.status}, ${errors.length} load error(s), ${tests} tests listed. One spec that cannot load makes Playwright collect no tests at all.`); for (const error of errors) console.error(`  ${error.message.split(`\n`)[0]}${error.location ? ` (${error.location.file}:${error.location.line})` : ``}`); } else console.log(`e2e load guard: ${config} lists ${tests} tests in ${files.size} files`); } process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);' playwright.config.ts playwright.courses.config.ts
